title: Apartment courtyard furniture exchange
brief:
Create a notice for the lobby boards at Tern Court Apartments inviting residents to a furniture exchange in the shared courtyard on October 10, 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Residents may bring up to two clean, usable small pieces that one person can carry, such as stools, side tables, or shelves. Drop-off opens at 10:45 a.m. Taking an item is free, and residents can browse without bringing anything. Participants must collect any items they brought that remain at 1 p.m. If it rains, the event moves to the ground-floor common room. Use a heading and make the timing easy to scan.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

e6c5ea15f28a3a82.text:
# Tern Court Apartments Furniture Exchange

**October 10 · Shared courtyard**

**10:45 a.m.** — Drop-off opens.  
**11 a.m. to 1 p.m.** — Browse and take home an item for free.  
**1 p.m.** — Please collect any items you brought that are still there.

Have a stool, side table, or shelf that could use a new home? Bring up to two clean, usable small pieces that one person can carry. All residents are welcome to browse, even if you don’t bring anything.

**Rain location** — Ground-floor common room.

# Tern Court Apartments Furniture Exchange

**October 10 · 11 a.m. to 1 p.m.**  
**Shared courtyard**  
**Drop-off opens at 10:45 a.m.**

Have a small piece of furniture to pass along? Bring up to two clean, usable pieces that one person can carry, such as stools, side tables, or small shelves.

Taking an item is free, and you’re welcome to browse even if you don’t bring anything.

**At 1 p.m.**, please collect any items you brought that are still there.

**If it rains**, the exchange will move to the ground-floor common room.
